evidence: The paper does not report or discuss feature importance at any point. The entire analysis focuses on clinical outcomes validation: survival times, response rates, and complete response duration in patients whose treatments matched model predictions (matching score > 0.5 threshold) versus those that did not. The matching score is determined by counting predictions above a threshold, not by importance magnitudes or rankings. Model development section mentions random forests and XGBoost as algorithm choices but never extracts or interprets importance values.
